name: Boon of Bloodshed

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: An enemy you see fall gives you Advantage on your next attack, and while Bloodied you add your Proficiency Bonus to one hit's damage each turn.

benefits.name: Taste of Blood
benefits.summary: When an enemy you can see drops to 0 Hit Points, you have Advantage on your next attack roll before the end of your next turn.
benefits.text: When an enemy you can see drops to 0 Hit Points, your next attack roll before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

benefits.name: Blood for Blood
benefits.summary: Once per turn while you're Bloodied, a hit adds your Proficiency Bonus to its damage.
benefits.text: Once per turn while you're Bloodied, when you hit with an attack you can add your Proficiency Bonus to its damage, of the attack's own damage type. It's added on its own unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
